FAQ

ProMax IPTV questions and troubleshooting

How do I place an order?

Choose a plan, then use its WhatsApp button. Support confirms availability, price and activation details before payment.

Can I request a trial?

Ask support on WhatsApp whether a trial is currently available for your device and server.

How many connections are included?

Each subscription plan includes one connection unless support confirms different terms.

Can I use one account on two devices?

You can install a player on more than one device, but simultaneous use is limited to the number of connections in your plan.

Which devices are supported?

Compatible players are available for Android, Fire TV, some Smart TVs, iOS and Windows. Check your exact model before ordering.

Is every channel in 4K?

No. Resolution depends on the source, your package, player, screen and internet connection.

What internet speed do I need?

A stable connection matters more than a headline speed. Test your connection on the device and ask support about your preferred quality.

Why is a channel buffering?

Check your Wi-Fi strength, restart the player and router, and try another channel. Share the channel name and time with support if it continues.

Why does a channel show a black screen?

Try another channel, restart the app and confirm your account is active. Report the channel name and device to support.

Why does the app say invalid login?

Check capitalization and spaces in your username, password or portal URL. Ask support to verify the details if it still fails.

What is a MAC address?

It is a device identifier used by some STB and portal-based players. Enter the exact MAC shown by the app when requested.

Can I change my device or MAC address?

Contact support before changing devices. Availability and transfer rules depend on your package.

Why does the playlist not load?

Check the URL and credentials, confirm your internet connection, and restart the player. If the issue remains, contact support.

Why is the EPG or TV guide empty?

Refresh the guide in the player and allow time for it to load. EPG coverage differs by channel and app.

Why are some movies unavailable?

On-demand availability can change. Send the title to support so they can check the current catalogue.

Why is the sound missing?

Check the device volume, audio track and player settings. Test another stream to determine whether it is channel-specific.

Why are subtitles missing?

Subtitle availability varies by source and player. Check the player subtitle menu and try another title.

Can I use a VPN?

A VPN may affect speed or routing. Ask support about compatibility and test your connection if playback changes.

Why does playback stop after a few minutes?

Check for an unstable connection, power-saving settings or an outdated app. Send your device model and time of failure to support.

How do I renew my subscription?

Contact support before expiry with your existing account details and preferred plan duration.

When does my plan start?

Support confirms the activation time and service period when your order is processed.

Are player app fees included?

Some player apps require their own licence. Confirm any app fee before purchase.

Can I install an APK on iPhone?

No. APK files are for Android. Use a compatible iOS player instead.

Why is my Firestick app not installing?

Check available storage, device compatibility and the download source. Older Firesticks may not support some players.

What if my Smart TV has no compatible app?

Ask support about another compatible player or an external streaming device.

How do reseller credits work?

A credit represents 12 months under the current pack rule. Confirm exact terms before ordering.

Can I renew a customer line with credits?

The reseller panel supports renewals; check available credits and the line status before proceeding.

Can I create a sub-reseller?

Ask support whether sub-reseller access is included with your chosen credit pack.

What if my credits are not visible?

Refresh the panel and check the correct account. Contact support with your order reference if the balance is still wrong.

How can I get technical help?

Contact support with your device model, player name, account type, error message and time of the problem. Do not share passwords publicly.
